primary_result: All 55 NH-HAZE development pairs and the native-resolution R10 three-action production-path probe were valid, but S0B is not authorized because the compact R10 action tuple check did not resolve from the selected summary field and the 55-image different-family planning proxy gives a mean-gain CI half-width of 0.062974 dB, above the frozen 0.020 dB precision requirement.
gate_reasons: Data integrity passed: 55 unique paired RGB images, exact ids 01-55, all 1600x1200, no pair or role hash duplicates, and GT was opened only after the action manifest was sealed.
Action transport passed on the pre-outcome SHA-selected image 14 for D_ref and D_rep: finite native-resolution renders, exact no-op, exact positive/negative latent sign symmetry and nonzero response.

Source code hashes, R10 terminal PASS and R14 route closure matched, but the action list was absent from the selected compact distribution field, so source_valid remained false pending read-only identity completion.

Image-level precision did not qualify: the different-action-family v2.7 proxy SD was 0.238282 dB and implied a 0.062974 dB mean CI half-width for 55 images; nested regions, actions, operators or raters may not inflate the independent sample count.

The zero-event exact UCB95 was 0.053011 and the concordance gate was arithmetically reachable only at 46 or more concordant images, but these two facts cannot rescue the failed mean-precision qualification.
competing_explanation: The valid single-image transport weakens a categorical action-incompatibility claim, but it does not establish target alignment or population-wide support; the precision failure may reflect the different v2.7 action-family proxy rather than the actual R10 action distribution.
limitations: Only one pre-outcome action-transport probe was run; no population utility was estimated.
NH-HAZE was already used by v2.7 and is development_screening, not an independent external validation population.
The precision proxy uses a different action family and is planning evidence only.
No semantic haze/protection labels or human naturalness ratings were collected.
This terminal does not alter R13/R14 or authorize training, S0B, confirmation, canary or locked-test access.
